card.name: "At least" in hepatitis B monitoring warnings
card.fires_on: The word "least" in "for at least several months" in warnings about monitoring liver function after stopping hepatitis B drugs. It also fires weakly on the gap just before a duration or dose figure, such as "is 48 weeks".
